evidence.observation: Pressure stepped abruptly from ~2.99 to ~3.23 Torr at t=3005 and returned to ~2.99 at t=3245, a ~0.24 Torr square excursion with no change in Ar flow, T, or heater power
Flow held 100 sccm throughout the pressure excursion, so the shift was not flow-driven
Temperature settled to 750 °C setpoint with heater power drifting 38%→45% during growth; cooldown proceeds normally
Exhaust O2 stayed 2-7 ppm throughout, no air ingress signature

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (Raman/AFM/optical) of the film, plus a pressure-gauge calibration or leak/exhaust check to confirm whether the 240 s pressure step was a real tube-pressure transient (partial exhaust restriction) or a gauge artifact.
